content_metadata.description: A video tutorial by Tyler Wood on tying three essential bushcraft knots: the Taut-line Hitch, Jam Knot, and Clover Hitch. Includes a giveaway announcement.

qAndA.question: What is the name of the first knot demonstrated?

qAndA.answer: Attaching items to your backpack using paracord.
qAndA.question: What is one practical use for the Jam Knot mentioned in the video?

qAndA.answer: To emphasize its ability to hold weight and remain secure.
qAndA.question: Why does Tyler highlight the strength of the Clover Hitch?

qAndA.answer: A roll of glow-in-the-dark poly rope.
qAndA.question: What is the prize for the giveaway?

qAndA.answer: By commenting on the video with their three favorite knots.
qAndA.question: How can viewers enter the giveaway?
